questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He bought ___ umbrella."
questions.explanation: Umbrella begins with a vowel sound, so "an" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "___ sun rises in the east."
questions.explanation: There is only one sun, so the definite article is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She is ___ honest girl."
questions.explanation: "Honest" begins with a silent h, giving a vowel sound, so "an" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "I saw ___ elephant in the zoo."
questions.explanation: Elephant begins with a vowel sound, so "an" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "___ Ganga is a holy river."
questions.explanation: Names of rivers take the definite article: the Ganga.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He is ___ European."
questions.explanation: European begins with a /y/ consonant sound, so "a" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She is ___ university student."
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /yoo/, so "a" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He waited for ___ hour."
questions.explanation: The h in hour is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Ravi is ___ best player in the team."
questions.explanation: A superlative takes the definite article.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "My father is ___ engineer."
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound. A profession after "is" takes a/an.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "She plays ___ guitar."
questions.explanation: Names of musical instruments take the definite article when we speak of playing them.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "___ Himalayas are in the north of India."
questions.explanation: A mountain range takes the definite article.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He goes to ___ school by bus."
questions.explanation: School is used for its usual purpose (as a student), so no article is needed.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "___ honesty is the best policy."
questions.explanation: An abstract noun used in a general sense takes no article.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "It was ___ one-day match."
questions.explanation: "One" begins with the consonant sound /w/, so "a" is used.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He is ___ MBA from a reputed institute."
questions.explanation: MBA is read "em-bee-ay", which begins with a vowel sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The rich are not always happy.
A rich are not always happy.
An rich are not always happy.
questions.explanation: "The" + an adjective names a group of people (the rich), and it takes a plural verb.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "We stayed at ___ Taj Mahal Hotel."
questions.explanation: Names of well-known hotels and landmarks usually take the definite article.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "Gold is ___ precious metal."
questions.explanation: "Precious metal" is a singular countable noun phrase, and "precious" begins with a consonant sound.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: "He bought ___ unique gift for her."
questions.explanation: "Unique" begins with the consonant sound /yoo/, so "a" is used.
